newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SFC suspends trade in Hansom shares.
newsitem.headline: SFC suspends trade in Hansom shares.

text.p: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) suspended trade in construction concern Hansom Holdings Ltd in the afternoon, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Wednesday.

"At the request of the Securities and Futures Commission, trading in the shares of Hansom Holdings Ltd will be suspended with effect from 2:30 p.m. (0630 GMT) today," the exchange said in a statement. Hansom shares, which had risen HK$1.125 or 30.41 percent in the last two trading days, were up a further HK$0.975 or 20.2 percent to HK$5.80 at midday on Wednesday.
Volume was 11.62 million shares worth HK$63.99 million.
Hansom said earlier in the day it was not aware of any reasons for the recent rise in the share price and turnover.
Last month, the company said it was in talks to sell a stake in a joint venture company.
